await page.goto('https://www.sixflags.com/select-park')
await page.evaluate(async()=>{const parse=t=>new DOMParser().parseFromString(t,'text/html');const links=d=>[...d.querySelectorAll('a[href]')];const a=links(document).find(a=>/frontier.?city/i.test(a.href+' '+a.textContent));const park=a?new URL(a.href).pathname.split('/').slice(0,2).join('/'):'/frontiercity';const t=await (await fetch(park)).text();const urls=[...new Set([...links(parse(t)).map(x=>x.getAttribute('href')),...(t.replaceAll('\\','').match(/\/[a-z-]*frontier[a-z-]*\/[^"<>\s]+/gi)||[])])];location.assign(urls.find(u=>/family-rides(?:$|\?)/.test(u))||urls.find(u=>/rides-experiences$|rides-and-experiences$|\/rides$/.test(u))||park+'/rides-experiences')})
await page.evaluate(()=>{const els=[...document.querySelectorAll('button,label,option,a')];const el=els.find(x=>/^family rides$/i.test(x.textContent.trim())&&x.getBoundingClientRect().width);if(el)el.click()})
await page.evaluate(()=>{const main=document.querySelector('main')||document.body;const family=[...main.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e=>e.children.length===0&&/^family ride(s)?$/i.test(e.textContent.trim()));let values=family.map(e=>{let p=e;for(let i=0;i<8&&p;i++,p=p.parentElement){const hs=p.querySelectorAll('h2,h3,h4');if(hs.length===1)return hs[0].textContent.trim()}return ''}).filter(Boolean);if(!values.length)values=[...main.querySelectorAll('h2,h3,h4')].filter(e=>e.getBoundingClientRect().width).map(e=>e.innerText.trim());return {url:location.href,title:document.title,h1:document.querySelector('h1')?.innerText,key_text:document.querySelector('h1')?.innerText,values,answer:values.join('\n')}})
